mentions.name: OpenPaint
mentions.description: A simple MS Paint-like cross-platform image editor for Mac, Linux, and Windows, revived as version 2.0 after 17 years. It stays faithful to the original Paint experience while adding quality-of-life improvements such as multiple tabs with image previews, cross-platform support, and a cleaned-up modernization of the old wxWidgets-based codebase.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've have jumped back into maintaining and cleaning up OpenPaint, a project I originally started about 17 years ago to bring a simple MS Paint-like editor to Mac, Linux, and Windows.
mentions.author: murdockq
